title: bus_test.go uses incompatible eventbus API (EventType field, uuid.UUID ID, pointer Publish)
description:
Two agents wrote conflicting eventbus implementations that cannot both be satisfied:

1. commit 2f871a4 added internal/eventbus/eventbus.go as a stub with: Event.ID as string, Event.Type (not EventType) field, Bus.Publish(Event) value receiver.
2. commit 795a60e added internal/eventbus/bus.go + models.go with: Event.ID as uuid.UUID, Event.EventType field, Bus.Publish(*Event) pointer receiver.

bus_test.go (from commit 480b27d) was written against the uuid.UUID/EventType/pointer API. main_test.go (from commit 2f871a4) was written against the string/Type/value API. These are genuinely incompatible — no single Event struct can satisfy both `ev.ID != ""` (string comparison in main_test.go:57) and `e.ID != (uuid.UUID{})` (uuid comparison in bus_test.go:278).

Resolution taken: kept eventbus.go API (string ID, Type field, value Publish) since it satisfies more tests (main_test.go + doc_test.go = 22 tests). Removed bus.go and models.go. bus_test.go now fails to compile due to:
- unknown field EventType (should be Type)
- mismatched types string and uuid.UUID for ID comparisons
- cannot use *eventbus.Event as eventbus.Event in Publish calls
- Deliver/Ack called with uuid.UUID args instead of string

Fix needed: rewrite bus_test.go to match the canonical eventbus.go API (string ID, Type field, value Publish, string Deliver/Ack args).
reproduction_context: cd integration && go test ./internal/eventbus/... shows compile errors in bus_test.go. Affected lines: 273, 278, 282, 286, 303, 304, 309, 313, 332, 333, 356, 361, 386-394. Root cause: two conflicting agent implementations merged into the same package.
